title: Closure theorem for compactly supported sequences (CL*), degree d + 1 < P: reduction to cycles (parent V3, V4, V15)
statement: Assume (MR), (IMC), (VO) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, dtc_vanish_off_support) and (Isor) (verbatim the second conjunct of sibling deformation). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P and assume CL_P(d) and BR_P(d) (as in sibling boundary_im). Then CL*_{P,d+1}: if K ⊆ ℝ^P is compact and T_j ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) are IM with IM boundaries, spt T_j ⊆ K for all j, sup_j(M(T_j) + M(∂T_j)) < ∞ and T_j ⇀ T, then T is IM.
